title: Profile: OpenAI Responses API and how it differs from Chat
goal: Items-based input/output, built-in tools, conversation state and streaming events, with an explicit mapping to and from Chat Completions. Author the machine-readable profile (endpoints, auth, versions, request/response shapes, errors, rate-limit signals, streaming, capability tags) in config/ecosystem/ and test it offline against recorded fixtures.
